newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate rises to 21.30 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate rises to 21.30 pct.

text.p: Mexico's 28-day interbank interest rate rose 12.50 basis points to 21.30 percent Wednesday from 21.1750 percent Tuesday, Banco de Mexico said.
The TIIP fell 168.12 basis points to 21.2923 percent Wednesday from 22.9735 percent the week before.
The 91-day TIIE fell 56.50 basis points to 23.17 percent Wednesday from 23.7350 percent the week before.
TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is replacing TIIP, an average interbank rate.
